captions.text:
Shot-view tips follow the
selected control scheme

Settings › Controls: the tip now
names all four schemes

Flick is the current scheme —
the shipping default

Flick: the first hole opens on
the cone tips — 1/6, as before

2/6 is the cone's aim slide —
Flick's own instruction

Switching to Pendulum from the
in-game gear…

…the pop-up explains the new
scheme, then CONFIRM commits it

Pendulum: the first hole opens on
the Pendulum tip — 1/5

No cone tips for Pendulum —
the shared four follow

Same physics, same course —
the tutorial matches the hand
